item.title: Alone in Gaza: Genocide leaves Palestinian man without family or a home
item.description: One man wanders Gaza in search of somewhere to sleep, having lost his family in an Israeli strike.

item.title: US sanctions leave Iranians facing flight cancellations and soaring costs
item.description: New US aviation sanctions force Iranians to take longer, costlier journeys as international flight routes disappear.

item.title: Rubio presses Lebanon on confiscation of weapons from Hezbollah
item.description: Lebanon's president reaffirms the commitment to bring all arms under state control.

item.title: Four killed as Indonesia battles worst forest fires in more than a decade
item.description: The deaths come as Jakarta says it will accept foreign help to tackle its worst forest fires in more than a decade.

item.title: Bystander guns down suspected primary school shooter in Oregon
item.description: Three children and a teacher were killed in a shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon.

item.title: Peshawar mourns children killed in school roof collapse
item.description: Thousands gather for funeral prayers in Pakistan’s Peshawar after a school rooftop collapse killed at least 34 children.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says ground troops unlikely in Iran; Saudi downs drone
item.description: President Trump says deployment of ground troops to Iran unlikely as Saudi Arabia downs drone in its Eastern Province.

item.title: Three children, one teacher killed in Oregon school shooting
item.description: The police chief in Bend, Oregon, identified the shooter as a 16-year-old who was killed by a bystander at the school.

item.title: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting
item.description: The suspect was shot dead by an armed bystander who followed him into the Oregon school, police said.

item.title: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded
item.description: Three children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher were killed after a 16-year-old suspect opened fire in the city of Bend, local police say.
